open_points.subject: R0-89 loss boundary
open_points.text: “That store begins its own history from the backup: every change after it is lost”
open_points.question: After which event are changes lost: after the backup was made, after the original store was lost, or after some other recovery boundary?
options: Every change committed after the restored backup's snapshot is absent
Only changes committed after the original store was declared lost are absent
A separately recorded recovery boundary determines what is absent
open_points.default_guess: Every change committed after the restored backup's snapshot is absent

open_points.subject: R0-89 and replay guarantees
open_points.text: R0-36 says “A create repeated after a lost answer … never silently makes a second project, customer or room,” while R0-89 says “Registry's guarantees … hold within each store's history.”
open_points.question: Does restoring a backup that predates a successful request permit the same request id to execute again and create another identity, or must replay protection survive across store histories?
options: Replay guarantees apply only within one store history, so the request may execute again after rollback
Replay protection must survive restoration and return the result created in the lost history
Such a replay must be refused because its prior outcome cannot be established
open_points.default_guess: Replay guarantees apply only within one store history, so the request may execute again after rollback
